items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Perry Como. I'd been on all the television shows in America.

ctx.x: I'd been on the Kate Smith Hour, I'd been on the Ford Hour, I'd been on the Windows of the World, I'd been on the -- this girl named Emerson had a program -- Faye Emerson I think it was. She had a television program. I was on that one. I was on the
-- what's his name? Perry Como. I'd been on all the television shows in America.
Was this Buck and Bubbles or just you?
